result.title: DUET4D: Self-Corrective Coupled Guidance for Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
result.summary: Sparse-view 4D reconstruction is highly under-constrained when only a few cameras are available. Generative priors can recover missing appearances, but video models are computationally impractical for iterative reconstruction, whereas single-view models produce temporally inconsistent pseudo-observations. Moreover, directly absorbing uncertain generative outputs into Gaussian optimization often creates redundant primitives and floating artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose DUET4D, a self-corrective coupled guidance framework for sparse-view 4D Gaussian splatting. The core of our approach is a self-corrective framework where the 4D representation guides generative prior for spatio-temporal consistent supervisions. We first construct sequential alignments from current Gaussian evidence to steer the latent restoration. Then we use Sequential Fidelity Resampling to lift generative supervisions into Gaussian space to selectively distinguish repeatedly supported primitives. The corrected representation then provides more reliable Gaussian evidence for the next restoration cycle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET4D significantly improves rendering quality and rendering efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DUET4D，让 4D 高斯表示与生成先验相互耦合迭代：先由当前高斯证据构造序列对齐以引导 latent 复原，再用 Sequential Fidelity Resampling 把生成监督提升到高斯空间并筛除冗余基元，从而改善稀疏视角 4D 重建的渲染质量与效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「表示给出证据→生成复原→按重复支持度重采样筛选」的闭环，可能与 LVR 中多轮视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态更新有概念关联，可供核查，但论文面向 3D/4D 重建，迁移性属推测。
